premise: Dog loves digging and noses up Clam, who loves digging too: she pushes out one strong foot and wriggles down into the sand, and they dig together all afternoon.
inspiration: The 'meeting your match' folk motif (two friends who both think they're the best at something), ending in sharing the thing they love.
lesson: It's more fun to share what you love.
learning: A clam digs down into the sand with one strong foot.

en-US.title: Dig, Dig, Dig
en-US.text: [excited] Dig, dig, dig! {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Dog loved digging more than anything. {dog:face happy} {dog:dust-puff} Sand flew everywhere, all round {castle:enter} the sand castle. {castle:wobble} Careful, Dog! [short pause] Then, {dog:face surprised} bonk. His nose found something hard and round. {clam:enter} It was Clam! {clam:live} She opened up to say hello, and closed again with a snap. [playfully] You like digging? said Clam. Me too! Watch this. She pushed out one strong foot, and wriggle, wriggle, wriggle… {clam:fade-out hold} she dug herself right down out of sight. [gasps] Gone! {dog:dust-puff} Dog dug and dug. {bucket:enter} The spade in the bucket {bucket:live} dug too, scoop, scoop. {dog:live} Dog shook the sand off his nose. [short pause] Then, {clam:fade-in} pop! Up came Clam. {clam:face happy} [laughs] Found you! said Dog. {dog:hop x2} {castle:sparkle} And they dug together all afternoon: one big paw, and one small, strong foot.

es-ES.title: Cava, cava, cava
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Cava, cava, cava! {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} A Perro le encantaba cavar más que nada en el mundo. {dog:face happy} {dog:dust-puff} La arena volaba por todas partes, alrededor {castle:enter} del castillo de arena. {castle:wobble} ¡Cuidado, Perro! [short pause] Entonces, {dog:face surprised} ¡bonc! Su hocico encontró algo duro y redondo. {clam:enter} ¡Era Almeja! {clam:live} Se abrió para saludar, y se volvió a cerrar. [playfully] ¿Te gusta cavar?, dijo Almeja. ¡A mí también! Mira esto. Sacó un pie fuerte, y meneo, meneo, meneo… {clam:fade-out hold} se enterró hasta desaparecer. [gasps] ¡Ya no está! {dog:dust-puff} Perro cavó y cavó. {bucket:enter} La pala del cubo {bucket:live} cavó también, zas, zas. {dog:live} Perro se sacudió la arena del hocico. [short pause] Entonces, {clam:fade-in} ¡pop! Salió Almeja. {clam:face happy} [laughs] ¡Te encontré!, dijo Perro. {dog:hop x2} {castle:sparkle} Y cavaron juntos toda la tarde: una pata grande, y un pie pequeño y fuerte.
